en: The postcard shows a black-and-white image of a pavilion structure labeled 'Helenenquelle' surrounded by lush trees and a landscaped garden. The building features decorative columns and ironwork. A woman in traditional attire is present inside the building. The reverse side of the postcard includes the stamps 'MUSEUM IM SCHLOSS BAD PYRMONT' and 'Verlag Geschw. Wolf, Bad Pyrmont' with handwritten numbers.
